designDecisions.reason: The live defect was an extractor boundary, so the source-role taxonomy, four-family gate, counter-evidence review, and Ranking policy remain unchanged.

technicalDetails.detail: The fallback accepts a capitalized adopter followed within a bounded sentence window by an explicit infinitive deployment or adoption verb, and only runs after the direct-verb matcher has no result.
